summary: Python 1.1 was a short-lived release. Van Rossum moved from CWI to CNRI (Corporation for National Research Initiatives) in Reston, Virginia, where he continued developing Python. The 1.1 release refined the language and standard library.
notes: Unsupported since 1994-11-10. Last micro 1.1.1. Support cycles were informal in the early 1990s.
